name: Kanhaiya Kumar Gandhi
role: Indian Congress politician and former JNU students’ union president
summary: Kumar advocates constitutional democracy, material freedom for poor people, opposition to caste hierarchy and women’s equality. His politics combines working-class internationalism with Indian patriotism and opposition to religious exclusion and the suppression of dissent.
